tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen, bar, wallpaper, lock screen and terminal background. Text on it: `fg`, `fg-muted`, `accent`, `alert`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Windows, launcher, popups, OSD. Solid, never transparent. Body text on it: `fg`, `fg-muted`. `alert` text reads 4.45:1 here, so use red as border or icon on surface, as text only on `bg`.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected launcher row and terminal selection: a lighter surface. Proposed value, the spec names the role but gives no hex.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Inactive window border, popup and launcher border, dividers, level-bar track. 1.5:1 on `bg`: the spec's value, kept exact. It separates by edge, not by contrast, so never rely on it to carry meaning.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `bg` and `surface`. Clock, window title, notification title, level-bar fill. 15.1:1 on `bg`.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and default status icons on `bg` and `surface`: notification body, type tags, bar icons, captions. 5.5:1 on `bg`, 5.0:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: fg-dim
tokens.usage: Empty workspace number only. Proposed value, the spec says dim without a hex. Decorative: 2.8:1 on `bg`, not for text that must be read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: amber. Active workspace fill, active window border, launcher selection marker, caret, typing border, unread count. Means focus, never caution. 9.3:1 on `bg`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an `accent` fill. Never white. 9.3:1 on `accent`.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Red: live mic or camera, recording, critical battery, network down, urgent popup border, wrong password. 4.8:1 on `bg`.

tokens.name: ansi-red
tokens.usage: Terminal red: muted and desaturated. Text on `bg`, 4.5:1 or better. Proposed value: the spec gives the rules, not the hex.

tokens.name: ansi-green
tokens.usage: Terminal green: muted and desaturated. Text on `bg`, 4.5:1 or better. Proposed value: the spec gives the rules, not the hex.

tokens.name: ansi-blue
tokens.usage: Terminal blue: muted and desaturated. Text on `bg`, 4.5:1 or better. Proposed value: the spec gives the rules, not the hex.

tokens.name: ansi-magenta
tokens.usage: Terminal magenta: muted and desaturated. Text on `bg`, 4.5:1 or better. Proposed value: the spec gives the rules, not the hex.

tokens.name: ansi-cyan
tokens.usage: Terminal cyan: muted and desaturated. Text on `bg`, 4.5:1 or better. Proposed value: the spec gives the rules, not the hex.

tokens.name: ansi-yellow
tokens.usage: Terminal yellow slot: amber. Check it against compiler warnings.

tokens.name: ansi-black
tokens.usage: Terminal black slot. Background use, not text.

tokens.name: ansi-white
tokens.usage: Terminal white slot. Text on `bg`.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-red
tokens.usage: Bright red: about 10% lighter than the base, not neon. Text on `bg`.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-green
tokens.usage: Bright green: about 10% lighter than the base, not neon. Text on `bg`.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-blue
tokens.usage: Bright blue: about 10% lighter than the base, not neon. Text on `bg`.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-magenta
tokens.usage: Bright magenta: about 10% lighter than the base, not neon. Text on `bg`.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-cyan
tokens.usage: Bright cyan: about 10% lighter than the base, not neon. Text on `bg`.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-yellow
tokens.usage: Bright yellow: amber lightened about 10%.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-black
tokens.usage: Bright black: comments and dim text. Same as `fg-muted`.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-white
tokens.usage: Bright white: same as `fg`.

styles.name: bar
styles.usage: Bar text, window title, clock. Proposed size, the spec only fixes the family.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Type tags, layout label, Caps Lock label. In `fg-muted`.

styles.name: arabic-body
styles.usage: Arabic titles, notifications, search input. Test with real titles.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The unit. Gap between any two things: window to window, window to bar, popup stack, icon to value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Bar edge padding, module gap, terminal padding, launcher icon to row edge.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Popup padding, launcher row side padding, icon to title gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Large inner padding, stage padding in previews.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Largest step: field to date on the lock screen, workspace button size.

tokens.name: border-w
tokens.usage: Every border. The only half-unit exception.

tokens.name: bar-h
tokens.usage: Bar height, 8 units.

tokens.name: ws-btn
tokens.usage: Workspace button, a square.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Bar and search icons. Launcher and popup app icons are 24px.

tokens.name: app-icon
tokens.usage: App icons in launcher rows and popups.

tokens.name: launcher-w
tokens.usage: Launcher width.

tokens.name: search-h
tokens.usage: Launcher search field and lock password field height.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Launcher result row height.

tokens.name: popup-w
tokens.usage: Mako popup width.

tokens.name: lock-field-w
tokens.usage: Lock password field width.

tokens.name: edge-gap
tokens.usage: Gap at screen edges: sides, bottom, bar to edge.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner. No exceptions: windows, bar, popups, fields, buttons.
